description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV1 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers in a media pipeline. It uses Google Test framework to verify reading video and audio data segments, including setup and data validation.

classes.name: DataReaderV1Tests
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing DataReaderV1 class, including setup, teardown, and specific read/write tests for video and audio segments.

methods.name: writeVideoData
methods.description: Prepares and writes a video media segment into shared memory buffer.

methods.name: readVideoData
methods.description: Reads and validates a video media segment from shared memory buffer.

methods.name: writeAudioData
methods.description: Prepares and writes an audio media segment into shared memory buffer.

methods.name: readAudioData
